Use `snl library list` to enumerate or search Librarys when an exact identity is not yet known.

### Agent procedure
1. Use `--query` only to narrow candidates and use cursor pagination until the required search is complete.
2. Choose an exact library slug from structured results, then call `snl library get` before relying on its current value.

### Machine-use contract
Invoke `snl library list` with an explicit `--root` and `--json`. Treat returned IDs and revisions as opaque. Branch on the structured status and exit code; do not scrape human-formatted output or edit `.SNL_Doc` files directly.
